header:
Empty string ("" + 0xFF pad) that CommonIDProc Strcpy's into the caller's dump buffer for EVT_DUMP_POINTER_EX (ID properties have no pointer form).
Basis: readers + bytes -- CommonIDProc_OnDumpPointerEx (CommonIDProc_CaseTable entry 2) pushes it and joins the Strcpy; bytes 00 FF.
evidence: ui/ui_widget_defs.s:17487-17491 `CommonIDProc_OnDumpPointerEx:` ... `pushw CommonIDProc_OnDumpPointerEx_Data@hi16/@lo16`
ui/ui_widget_defs.s:17496 `call Strcpy` -- copied into (xwa+4) of the request
ui_widgets/disk_warning_strings.s:1136 `.short CommonIDProc_OnDumpPointerEx - CommonIDProc_OnGetPropDataSp` -- the case-table slot
ui_widgets/disk_warning_strings.s:1131 `.incbin ..., 0x1F36, 0x2` -- bytes 00 FF (sibling ConstFlagProc_DumpText / NameProc_MakeDump_Str_Empty)

header:
"BM": the BMP file signature DrawBitmapFile_Impl checks (String_Compare, 2 chars) before drawing a bitmap file; mismatch returns.
Basis: readers + bytes -- sibling of CaptureLcd_Str_BM; bytes 42 4D 00 FF.
evidence: ui/drawing_primitives.s:3485-3490 `pushw 0x2` / `pushw DrawBitmapFile_Impl_Data@hi16/@lo16` / `call String_Compare`
ui/drawing_primitives.s:3493 `jrl nz, DrawBitmapFile_Impl_Return` -- not a BMP: nothing drawn
ui_widgets/disk_warning_strings.s:1146 `.incbin ..., 0x2146, 0x4` -- bytes 42 4D 00 FF = "BM"

header:
"BM": the BMP signature Gfx_LoadSplashBMP compares with the first 2 bytes of the 14-byte file header it just read; mismatch fails validation.
Basis: readers + bytes -- bytes 42 4D 00 FF; same use as DrawBitmapFile and CaptureLcd_Str_BM.
evidence: ui/ui_window_procs.s:6249-6252 `ld xbc, 0xe` / `call FileIO_ReadBlock` / `cp iz, 0xe` -- reads the 14-byte BITMAPFILEHEADER
ui/ui_window_procs.s:6254-6259 `pushw 0x2` / `pushw Gfx_LoadSplashBMP_Data@hi16/@lo16` / `call String_Compare`
ui/ui_window_procs.s:6262 `jr nz, FileIO_ControllerValidationFailed`
ui_widgets/disk_warning_strings.s:1192 `.incbin ..., 0x219C, 0x4` -- 42 4D 00 FF

header:
128 x char[9]: MIDI note name per note number, C-2 .. G8, every character written as a "~hh" escape (~a0 = flat glyph, ~9e = sharp), e.g. "~43~2d~32" = "C-2"; Strncpy'd 9 bytes at note*9.
Basis: readers + bytes -- NoteEditFunc_OnGetNoteString (title TT_SQNOTEEDT) and SqedtFunc_OnGetTnString/CnString index it by a note byte * 9.
evidence: sequencer/sequencer_ui.s:6732-6747 `NoteEditFunc_OnGetNoteString:` `cp l, 0x95` (TITLE_SQNOTEEDT) / `pushw 0x9` / `muls wa, 0x9` / `lda xbc, (NoteEdit_FormatTempoString_Data:24)` / `call Strncpy`
sequencer/sequencer_ui.s:14279-14296 `SqedtFunc_OnGetTnString:` `ld a, (9750:16)` / `muls wa, 9` / table / Strncpy 9
sequencer/sequencer_ui.s:14303-14320 `SqedtFunc_OnGetCnString:` `ld a, (9816:16)` / `muls wa, 9` -- same table
includes/generated/naka_effects_seq.bin 0x89A2..0x8E22 = 1152 B = 128 x 9; decoded: C-2, D~a0-2(Db), D-2, ... C8, Db8, D8, Eb8, E8, F8, F#8, G8 (scratch agent_g5 python decode)
ui_widgets/style_bitmaps.s:3639 MainChordPre_RootNames header -- ~a0 is the flat glyph escape, ~9e the sharp one
spelling: The 1152-byte table is cut into three incbins: this label covers entries 0..53 and 7 bytes of 53; Str_20469e32473220 (+484) and Str_42a03242322043 (+523) are mid-entry splits whose old `.long` referrers no longer exist (only comments mention them) -- they should be merged into one table.
